notes: Reviewed assignment of imported procedure slots to reusable recipe modules.

A requirement joins a shared module only by an explicit entry here. Matching role codes, similar labels, and clinical resemblance never create membership on their own — the same role legitimately appears more than once on a card, and two procedures can want the same role in materially different ways.

'definitionSourceSlotId' names the imported row whose content the module carries. 'sourceSlotAliases' names the rows that requirement absorbed; they are kept so modifier targeting and audit trails written against the original ids keep working.

'remainingSlotsFromProcedure' assigns every slot of one procedure that no other module in this file claims. It is the identity mapping — it creates no cross-procedure equivalence — and it is how a procedure with no reviewed core mapping keeps its current card exactly.

modules.name: Flexible Bronchoscopy Core
modules.description: The imaging and suction setup every flexible bronchoscopy shares, whatever is done through the scope.

requirements.reason: EBUS-TBNA and therapeutic flexible bronchoscopy both open with a compatible video processor and light source. The two imported rows differ only in label wording; role, requiredness, selection mode, quantity, section, and generic requirement are identical.

Both procedures require a suction source with tubing and canisters as a multiple-selection line. The therapeutic card's high-flow expectation and the EBUS card's aspiration syringes are restored as procedure notes rather than by forking the requirement.

modules.name: Therapeutic Bronchoscopy Core
modules.description: The therapeutic platform shared by flexible airway intervention: a large-channel therapeutic bronchoscope and flexible grasping forceps.

requirements.reason: Therapeutic flexible bronchoscopy and endobronchial valve placement both require a therapeutic bronchoscope, with byte-identical label, generic requirement, role, requiredness, selection mode, quantity, and section. The valve card's channel-matching note is restored by a composition action.

Both rows carry the identical generic requirement 'Flexible forceps for foreign body or tissue retrieval' in the Retrieval section. The valve card's requiredness, dependency, and retrieval-specific wording are restored by composition actions rather than by keeping two copies of one requirement.

modules.name: Pleural Procedure Core
modules.description: The ultrasound setup every pleural intervention is planned around.

requirements.reason: Thoracentesis, chest tube insertion, tunnelled IPC placement, and medical thoracoscopy all open on an ultrasound machine with a sterile probe cover, as a single-selection Imaging line with the same quantity. The chest-tube card's optional requiredness and image-guidance condition, and the IPC card's pleural-access wording, are restored by composition actions.

modules.name: Procedural Fluoroscopy
modules.description: Mobile C-arm and the radiation protection that has to be in the room with it. Included by default where the imported template already asked for it, and available to add where fluoroscopy is a local practice.

requirements.reason: The EBUS-TBNA and therapeutic-bronchoscopy C-arm rows are identical in every field except display order.
The two radiation-protection rows are identical in every field except display order, and travel with the C-arm rather than standing alone.

modules.name: EBUS-TBNA specific requirements
modules.description: What EBUS-TBNA needs beyond the flexible bronchoscopy core: the linear EBUS scope, its ultrasound chain, and the needle and specimen workflow.
modules.reason: Every EBUS-TBNA row not claimed by the flexible bronchoscopy core or the fluoroscopy module.

modules.reason: Every therapeutic-bronchoscopy row not claimed by the flexible bronchoscopy core, the therapeutic bronchoscopy core, or the fluoroscopy module.
